roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description: We are seeking a dedicated Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital full-time role offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, providing an excellent opportunity for a skilled professional to make a significant impact.In this dual-focused position, you will be instrumental in both enhancing staff competencies through comprehensive education programs and ensuring the highest standards of infection prevention and control. Your expertise will be crucial in maintaining a safe and compliant environment for both residents and staff.If you are an experienced Registered Nurse passionate about staff education and infection control, and ready to contribute to a supportive team, we encourage you to apply today.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development or adult education
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.
